decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The two storey side extension due to its size, scale, and position forward of No 16a Bridge Road, would be harmful to the residents living conditions of this property through loss of daylight, loss of out look, and also have an overbearing appearance. This would be harmful to the appearance of the area contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations), and supplementary guidance for Residential Extension Guidelines, of the adopted Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.
Condition : 2 - The two storey side extension due to its size, scale, appearance, and prominent position of the building, projecting forward of No.16a Bridge Road, would not be in keeping with the character and style of the existing house and surrounding properties.  This would be harmful to the appearance of the area contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations), and supplementary guidance for Residential Extension Guidelines, of the adopted Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.
description: Erection of a two storey side extension  and single storey rear extension to house.
